$comment: CWN Free Edition parity matrix (#1025). Generated by tools/cwn_parity_audit.py from the linked SRD's own navigation. Status is derived from evidence: 'implemented' requires a matching module AND an existing test; 'partial' is a module with no test naming it. Evidence is matched by module filename and by procedure name/docstring tokens, so the module list is a candidate set, not a semantic equivalence proof: a row may cite a module that mentions the section without implementing it. Status answers 'is there code and a test', not 'does it match the book' — that is what tested_against_book records. pdf_page is null because the PDF is not in the repository and a page number must be read from the book, never guessed. tested_against_book/save_safe/playtested are separate columns precisely so file existence cannot be read as verification.

srd.scope_note: Sections captured from the hosted SRD navigation. The linked SRD omits Antagonists and the GM material present in the Free Edition PDF; those are therefore absent from this matrix rather than claimed. The PDF is the authoritative reference; where the two differ the PDF wins and the row records the divergence.

rows.divergence: Skill pools, per-rank point costs and rank caps.

Derived numbers (HP, saves, attack bonus) and contacts are implemented. The starting-credits / equipment-package step has no procedure: a starting character's purse is a table decision in this implementation.
Hit resolution, target number and the situational modifier list.

The SRD section covers shoving and grappling (opposed Str/Punch, prone, escape, forced movement), the two-weapon penalty and execution attacks. No procedure in src/rules implements any of them and no test names them; filling this needs new code, not a re-reading of existing code.
Mortals, stabilization difficulty and the downed procedure.
The d12 major-injury table, its clamping and the prosthetic requirement.
Chase rounds, hindrances and the foot/vehicle modifier split.

The catalogue is data (data/rules/cwn_equipment.json, 35 weapons); the module resolves stats, damage and the trauma/shock flags. The NoöPunk equipment chapter is deliberately descriptive and defers numeric economy to CWN (author directive 2026-10-07); the rulebook anchor is therefore the baseline pointer, not a restatement of the numbers here.
Armour pieces and armour mods are implemented; the SRD's separate accessory items (comms, vision, environment gear) are not modelled as their own catalogue.
Surgeon modifiers, theatre grade, cost, repeat-attempt penalty and the surgery check.
Gentle and brutal removal, salvage from a corpse and reuse of recovered hardware.
Concealment ranks and scanner detection.
Levels, the jack I/II physical-skill gate, the automatic-failure range including crosstalk, and the scene lockout.
Theatre grade 0 models 'a cyberdoc kit and nothing else' as the -1 row; there is no separate cyberdoc-tool catalogue with weights and prices.

Monthly costs added by #1068; the System Strain half already lived in cwn_core and is reused, not copied. The NoöPunk equipment chapter is deliberately descriptive and defers numeric economy to CWN (author directive 2026-10-07); the rulebook anchor is therefore the baseline pointer, not a restatement of the numbers here.

Added by #1068 from the SRD's 18-row daily-wage table. The NoöPunk equipment chapter is deliberately descriptive and defers numeric economy to CWN (author directive 2026-10-07); the rulebook anchor is therefore the baseline pointer, not a restatement of the numbers here.

Added by #1068 from the SRD's favour-multiple table, including the 'serious risk' flag. The NoöPunk equipment chapter is deliberately descriptive and defers numeric economy to CWN (author directive 2026-10-07); the rulebook anchor is therefore the baseline pointer, not a restatement of the numbers here.
Program catalogue, verb costs and access requirements.
The deck bonus feeds the access pool and deck mods are supported; the SRD's cyberdeck hardware catalogue (models, prices, slots) is not modelled.
The module documents the wireless-link penalty and refuses to ship a node graph the author has not ruled on; node-to-node links and their verb costs are therefore not implemented.
